disclaimer: Informational only. Provincial criteria change without notice and several provinces publish intake-by-intake. Verify against the province's own page before acting.

national_context.quebec_note: Under the Canada-Quebec Accord, Quebec selects its own economic immigrants. There is no Quebec PNP and a Quebec destination cannot be chosen through Express Entry.

verification_legend.verified: Stream criteria read from the province's own published page on the recorded date.
verification_legend.unverified: The province operates a PNP, but its streams have not been checked against the province's page. Code must NOT assert eligibility from an unverified entry — surface it as 'check directly' instead.

provinces.name: Ontario
provinces.program_note: Ontario has closed every other OINP stream. The Workforce Priority stream is the only route currently published as open, and it is job-offer led — the Human Capital and Masters/PhD Graduate streams that once let candidates apply without an employer are gone.

streams.label: Ontario Workforce Priority Stream
streams.ee_note: Express Entry alignment applies to TEER 0-3 applicants who opt in; a nomination then adds 600 CRS points.
streams.min_education: Post-secondary credential of at least one year for TEER 0-3 (non-trades); secondary school for trades and TEER 4-5.
streams.min_experience_note: TEER 0-3: 6 months consecutive full-time in the offered position, or 2 years cumulative in the NOC, or 3 months for recent Ontario graduates. TEER 4-5: 9 months cumulative full-time within 2 years.
streams.occupation_note: All NOC occupations across every TEER are eligible; the constraint is the job offer, not the occupation.
streams.job_offer_exception: Self-employed physicians may apply without a job offer if they hold an OHIP billing number and membership in the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Ontario.

provinces.name: British Columbia
provinces.program_note: BC no longer runs general skilled-worker draws. In 2026 it invites almost exclusively within named sectors — childcare, health, education, veterinary care and construction trades — plus a small high-wage 'economic impact' route. A strong profile in an unlisted occupation is not being invited at any score.

streams.label: Skills Immigration — Skilled Worker (EEBC option available)
streams.ee_note: The Express Entry BC (EEBC) option requires an existing profile in the federal pool.
streams.general_route_note: Outside the targeted sectors, the High Economic Impact route required a job offer paying roughly $62/hour and $125,000/year, or a BC PNP score of 138, at the 2026-04-22 round.

streams.label: Skills Immigration — Health Authority
streams.occupation_note: For candidates with an offer from one of BC's public health authorities. TEER level is not the constraint; the employer is.

provinces.name: Alberta
provinces.program_note: Alberta runs the most accessible no-job-offer route in the country: the Alberta Express Entry Stream draws directly from the federal pool, with dedicated pathways for health care, technology and policing.

streams.label: Alberta Express Entry Stream
streams.ee_note: Alberta searches the federal Express Entry pool and issues notifications of interest. You cannot apply directly — you must already have an active profile.
streams.occupation_note: Dedicated pathways exist for health care, technology and police occupations. Other occupations are selected against Alberta's stated provincial priorities.

streams.label: Alberta Opportunity Stream
streams.ee_note: Base stream — a nomination here leads to a direct PR application, not 600 CRS points.
streams.occupation_note: For candidates already working in Alberta on a valid work permit.

streams.label: Rural Renewal Stream
streams.occupation_note: Requires a job offer from an employer in a designated rural Alberta community, plus a community endorsement letter.

streams.label: Tourism and Hospitality Stream
streams.occupation_note: Restricted to the tourism and hospitality sector.

provinces.name: Saskatchewan
provinces.program_note: Saskatchewan keeps a no-job-offer route open, but it is gated by an Excluded Occupation List and by 2026 sector caps: 15% of nominations for food service and accommodation, 5% for trucking, 5% for retail trade.

streams.label: International Skilled Worker — Saskatchewan Express Entry
streams.min_education: Post-secondary education or training comparable to at least one year of Canadian study.
streams.occupation_note: Your occupation must not appear on the SINP Excluded Occupation List, which applies to this sub-category and to Occupations In-Demand. Excluded occupations may still qualify under the Employment Offer sub-category with a registered employer.

streams.label: International Skilled Worker — Occupations In-Demand
streams.ee_note: Base stream — leads to a direct PR application rather than 600 CRS points, and does not require a federal Express Entry profile.
streams.occupation_note: Subject to the same Excluded Occupation List as the Express Entry sub-category.

streams.label: International Skilled Worker — Employment Offer
streams.occupation_note: The route for occupations excluded from the other two sub-categories. Requires an employer approved through an Employer Position Assessment.

provinces.name: Newfoundland and Labrador
provinces.program: Newfoundland and Labrador Provincial Nominee Program (NLPNP)
